summary: School and library advocates urge FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to ensure schools have reliable internet access for students and staff.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate, schools would lose critical connectivity for students and teachers
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, if our school lost funding, students would lose tools that they use to access e-books, take assessments, and access to their progress in learning in real time. Teachers would lose access to instant data that we use to drive both whole group and small group instruction.
